_comment: Template only; materialize_text.py refuses it as-is. Two SEPARATE completed records are required before any text is shown to annotators: (1) decision_type 'rights_permission', recorded from the written reply of the data provider / rights holder (for MyGov: MyGov/MeitY/NIC); (2) decision_type 'ethics_approval' or 'ethics_exemption', recorded from the institution's written ethics decision. Each is completed only by transcribing a real written decision, is stored outside git, and must cite that document in evidence_reference. See docs/annotation/MYGOV_PERMISSION_REQUEST.md and docs/annotation/ETHICS_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md.
